items.title: 一条负残差并不够：网络定位中负曲率的结构
items.title_en: One Negative Residual Is Not Enough: The Structure of Negative Curvature in Network Localization
items.excerpt: 记录一条退化的对偶下界路线如何经由投影边预算、应力-刚度分解与多边耦合，转向驻点附近的负曲率问题。
items.excerpt_en: A July 2026 research record on how a failed dual lower-bound route led from projected edge budgets to stress-rigidity structure, multi-edge coupling, and dimension-dependent saddles.
items.reading_time_zh: 2026 年 7 月研究记录 · 持续合作

items.title: Theorem 11 必要性方向中的凸性问题
items.title_en: Convexity in the Necessity Direction of Theorem 11
items.excerpt: 梳理 Theorem 11 必要性方向中的凸化步骤，检查 envelope submeasure、fragmentation numbers，以及从一般分布类 U 进入 Lemma 18 与 Theorem 19 所需凸性条件的桥接。
items.excerpt_en: A note on the convexification step in the necessity direction of Theorem 11, including the envelope submeasure, fragmentation numbers, and the bridge from a general distribution class U to the convex setting used in Lemma 18 and Theorem 19.

items.title: 稀疏化后的 Exact Huber GLMs：Active Curvature 与 Kink Switching
items.title_en: Exact Huber GLMs after Sparsification: Active Curvature and Kink Switching
items.excerpt: 研究稀疏化后的局部 refinement 是否能够保留 exact Huber loss 的 active quadratic curvature，同时控制 affine-tail behavior 与 Huber kink 附近的切换。
items.excerpt_en: A note on whether sparsified local refinement can preserve the active quadratic curvature of exact Huber losses while controlling affine-tail behavior and switching near the Huber kink.

items.title: 子模贪心算法形式化正式进入 AFP
items.title_en: Formalizing Submodular Greedy Is Now in the AFP
items.excerpt: 记录 Isabelle/HOL 子模贪心算法形式化正式发表于 Archive of Formal Proofs，以及形式化过程中逐渐显露出的算法证明结构。
items.excerpt_en: A short reflection on the publication of an Isabelle/HOL formalization of submodular greedy algorithms in the Archive of Formal Proofs, and on the proof architecture exposed by formalization.

items.title: 从 dual score 到 saddle certificates 的一点新进展
items.title_en: From Dual Score to Saddle Certificates: A Small New Step
items.excerpt: 三月留下来的 dual score 原本只是 instance-level structural score；最近它开始和 differentiable stationary points、stationary dual witness、projected retention、Hessian negative curvature 以及 cycle-rank saddle certificates 接起来。
items.excerpt_en: A new step from an instance-level dual score toward stationary witnesses, projected retention, Hessian structure, and cycle-rank saddle certificates for network localization.

items.title: 从子模优化之后继续往前：Projected Gradient Descent in Isabelle/HOL
items.title_en: Moving Forward After Submodular Optimization: Projected Gradient Descent in Isabelle/HOL
items.excerpt: 这篇 5 月 22 日的原始笔记记录第二个 Isabelle/HOL optimization 项目的结构；它早于子模贪心条目 5 月 26 日的 AFP 发表。PGD 项目随后于 7 月 2 日提交 AFP，目前等待审核。
items.excerpt_en: Originally posted on May 22, this note records the structure of a second Isabelle/HOL optimization project and predates the AFP publication of the submodular entry on May 26. The PGD project was submitted to AFP on July 2 and is awaiting review.

items.title: 当一个 dual 路线走不通时，我真正得到的东西
items.title_en: What I Really Got When a Dual Route Failed
items.excerpt: 当两条最自然的 Lagrangian dual 路线都塌到 trivial 0 bound 之后，留下来的反而是一个和 Range(B)、cycle consistency 与 instance difficulty 相关的 dual-based structural score。
items.excerpt_en: When the most natural Lagrangian dual routes collapse to the trivial 0 bound, what remains is a dual-based structural score tied to Range(B), cycle consistency, and instance difficulty.

items.title: 从一个定理到一套框架：我的 Isabelle 子模优化项目新进展
items.title_en: From One Theorem to a Framework: New Progress on My Isabelle Project in Submodular Optimization
items.excerpt: 原文发布于 3 月 14 日；7 月更新仅补充后续状态。子模贪心条目于 5 月 26 日正式发表于 AFP，发表后仓库继续发展 StochasticGreedy theorem line。
items.excerpt_en: Originally posted on March 14; the July update adds later status without changing the original date. The submodular entry was published in AFP on May 26, and the repository continued afterward with the StochasticGreedy theorem line.

items.title: Metalcore Piano Lab｜从音频到谱面：一个离散化的实验（WIP）
items.title_en: Metalcore Piano Lab | From Audio to Chart: A Discretization Experiment (WIP)
items.excerpt: 从连续音频到可玩的谱面：起音检测、节拍网格、段落对齐与可玩性约束。
items.excerpt_en: From continuous audio to playable charts: onset detection, beat grids, section alignment, and playability constraints.

items.title: Spring 2026｜新科研记录的开始
items.excerpt: 从纯数学走向优化研究：一个学期的研究训练与新的问题切入口。
items.excerpt_en: Beginning undergraduate research in Cornell ORIE on first-order methods for constrained and composite optimization.

items.title: 早期项目记录：Submodular Greedy 的 Isabelle 形式化
items.title_en: Early Project Note: Formalising Submodular Greedy
items.excerpt: 2025年12月的阶段记录；项目此后已于 AFP 2026 正式发表，当前仓库另含发表后的 StochasticGreedy 扩展。
items.excerpt_en: A December 2025 stage record; the project was subsequently published in AFP 2026, and the current repository also contains a post-publication StochasticGreedy extension.

items.title: 我的第一个 Isabelle 形式化证明
items.excerpt: 把可验证性嵌进证明过程：从动机到 Nemhauser–Wolsey theorem。
items.excerpt_en: Embedding verifiability into proof writing: from motivation to the Nemhauser–Wolsey theorem.
